hero.headline: Building digital products from frontend to backend.
hero.intro: I’m Dmytro, a Full-Stack Developer based in the Netherlands. I build modern web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a strong focus on architecture, performance, and maintainable code.

about.heading: End-to-end ownership, from the data model to the last pixel.
about.p1: I have spent the last three years building web applications in production: two years as a front-end developer on an AI-powered crypto trading platform, and before that as a full-stack engineer on platforms for educational and humanitarian initiatives.
about.p2: Alongside that work I build complete applications on my own — designing the API and the database, handling authentication, writing the frontend and deploying it. I care about clear architecture and code that the next developer can understand.
about.p3: I use AI tools such as Claude Code and ChatGPT as part of a workflow I stay in control of: they speed up analysis, debugging and repetitive work, and I review and validate everything they produce.

skills.heading: Technologies I work with
skills.intro: The core stack I use every day comes first. The rest are tools I have used in projects or at work.

projects.heading: Selected work
projects.intro: Real products, each with a case study covering the architecture, decisions and trade-offs behind it.

understand.title: Understand the problem
understand.body: Analyse the requirements, the users’ needs and the business context before writing code.

design.title: Design the solution
design.body: Plan the application architecture, API boundaries, data models and technical choices.

build.title: Build and implement
build.body: Develop frontend and backend functionality with the technologies that fit the problem.

ai.title: AI-assisted development
ai.body: Use Claude Code and ChatGPT for code analysis, implementation support, debugging and refactoring. I stay responsible for reviewing and validating the output.

ship.title: Test and deploy
ship.body: Verify the functionality, keep code quality high, run the tests and deploy the application.

contact.heading: Have a project in mind or looking for a Full-Stack Developer?
contact.body: I’m based in Ede and open to roles across the Netherlands. The quickest way to reach me is by email.
